title: Pop Caps
description: A simple mod that adds bottle caps for use as currency.
body:
A simple mod that adds bottle caps as currency.

This is not programmed into the loot tables of any mobs or chests so you will need to create your own modpack to add them, or use loot-changing mods.

Combaining 9 bottle caps ![bottle cap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c02bf70a93ca3297b29dcf279281688649d9efd2.png) gives you a cap stack ![bottle cap stack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2400a092628ca8f0cc0bbbf3df1150a45f94eae.png)

![recipe for the cap stack - 3x3 grid of bottle caps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88fedbec13bc7b67e844c2f93165d501963f7066.png)

Combining 9 cap stacks ![bottle cap stack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2400a092628ca8f0cc0bbbf3df1150a45f94eae.png) gives you a bag ![bottle cap bag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c23bca7a4e018be84bdf70c2fd585a72c83cc5c2.png)

![recipe for the cap bag - 3x3 grid of cap stacks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe9d79bd913f20bf39d69332ce2822aecfc515b3.png)

Melting one cap in a furnace gives you one iron nugget

![recipe for melting a cap into an iron nugget in the furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edf4e73ced8787d561dc6b99bb5dd6737d5d9132.png)

Only avaliable in Forge 1.20.1, made in MCreator

(This is my first mod I don't know what I'm doing lol)



Recommended to use with:

- [Configurable Extra Mob Drops](https://modrinth.com/mod/configurable-extra-mob-drops)
- [Custom Villager Trades](https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-villager-trades)
